site_metadata.site_description: Poudre at Lincoln St above Lincoln St Outflow
site_metadata.housing_description: Upstream of USGS gauge, downstream of bridge, left bank. 20ft high flow housing and 10 ft deployable low flow housing.

Chl-a Fluorescence.calibration_method: Yearly two-point calibration of sensor using DI (0 RFU) and rhodamine dye (500 μg/L, 2.9 RFU)

DO.calibration_method: 100 % saturation in-air calibration using wetted sponge
DO.Notes: Stream morphology (ie. pool vs riffle) and shading patterns may affect readings

Depth.calibration_method: If AquaTROLL only, depth is calibrated using onboard barometric pressure sensor to in air conditions. If AquaTroll and Vulink are deployed together, VuLink Barometric Pressure compensation is applied
Depth.Notes: Sensor Housing shifts or bank changes are not accounted for in this dataset and depth is relative to current site conditions

FDOM Fluorescence.calibration_method: One-point calibration using solid state calibration block (8.25 RFU)

Specific Conductivity.calibration_method: Pre-2024: One point with 1413 μS/cm 2024 onwards: Two-point with either DI (0.1 μS/cm) and 147 μS/cmstandard or 147 μS/cm and 1413  μS/cm depending on site range.

Temperature.Notes: Stream morphology (ie. pool vs riffle) and shading patterns may affect readings

Turbidity.calibration_method: Two-point calibration using 10 NTU and 100 NTU standards

calibration_note: Methods describe standard procedures, not proof a calibration occurred at a particular time.
visit_note_availability_assumption: Historical replay assumption: visit notes become available at the next UTC midnight. The source provides visit times, not the actual times when notes were entered.

visit_records.visit_comments: Calibrations went well. I swapped the batteries and the aqua troll would not power up. I took the rechargeable batteries out out the sensor and left the sonde in the housing without batteries. The recharge batteries are recharging at the lab. I downloaded the log and started a new one. However it is not logging due to battery issue

Jed had pulled sonde due to battery issues. Came to site to replace batteries, calibrate FDOM and deploy sonde. Calibration went just fine. Rechargeable batteries have low voltage, 27%. Will need to replace batteries soon but wanted to have log running. could not synchronize upon start a visit, but was able to test upload just fine. Low flows at housing today, modified a few rocks to increase flows at low flow housing, and cleaned algae from high flow housing.
